name: Mephibosheth
bio: Mephibosheth was the son of Jonathan and grandson of Saul. He was five years old when news came of Saul and Jonathan's deaths at Jezreel; his nurse picked him up and fled in panic, and in her haste he fell and was crippled in both feet from then on (2 Samuel 4:4). The story of grace that later unfolds between Mephibosheth and David, rooted in David's covenant with Jonathan, is told in detail through the rest of 2 Samuel.
